'''Grimwater River'''<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|33|Miregill Distraction}}</ref> is is a river that runs from [[Lake Kithas]] in the [[Grim Reaches]] and empties into the [[Forbidding Sea]]. Led by [[Gargill the Butcher]], a group of [[Miregill]] [[murloc]]s has gathered along Grimwater's southern bank, threatening the local dwarven fishermen.
